body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Tactical enthusiast from Budapest who genuinely gets excited by ideas. Voice direction: Higher, quick female voice with a light Hungarian accent. Fast lively pacing, a laugh in the voice and crisp words; excited, never shrill. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, look at this! The defender steps away, and suddenly that piece is hanging. The other side grabs it immediately. Spot it before they do!
